public_rationale: The PhysGame preprint, available December 2, 2024, reports average accuracy of 56.1% for GPT-4o and 55.2% for Gemini-1.5-pro on questions about physics violations in gameplay videos [e1]. This provides limited evidence of physical-reasoning weaknesses, but does not establish broad reliability across physical and spatial problems [e1]. It does not retest the specific earlier GPT-3 mistakes, so it cannot settle the claim that those errors were corrected while broader weaknesses remained [e1].
limitations: The packet contains no independent matched retests of the cited GPT-3 failure cases.
PhysGame covers a narrower task than general understanding of the external world.
The cited passages do not establish exact experimental dates within October 1, 2024 through January 5, 2025.
